summary: Laris Geardawdle seeks pure oozes across Kalimdor after learning they absorb the corruption of places like Felwood. He needs clean samples to study how these creatures adapt to their surroundings.

sections.title: A Matter of Purity
sections.body: Laris Geardawdle's early experiments in Ironforge ran into a problem: the oozes he examined carried the dark taint of Felwood. Their corruption showed him that oozes absorb and reflect the traits of the places they inhabit, but left him without a clean comparison. He needs specimens untouched by demonic taint or urban filth to learn what ooze life is like on its own.

sections.title: Tracking the Primal Slime
sections.body: Pure slimes are hard to find on an Azeroth scarred by corruption and war. Far to the south, Glutinous Oozes thrive in the isolated, primordial wilderness of prehistoric Un'Goro Crater. Samples from these wild creatures give Laris the pure material he needs to study how oozes interact with Azeroth's living biomes.

faq.q: Why does Laris Geardawdle need pure ooze samples?
faq.answer: Laris's earlier specimens carried Felwood's corruption. To test his belief that slimes adapt to and reflect their surroundings, he needs pure specimens from an unpolluted habitat as a clean baseline.

faq.q: Where are the pure oozes located?
faq.answer: Glutinous Oozes live in the prehistoric wilderness of Un'Goro Crater, far south in Kalimdor.
Laris Geardawdle is a gnomish researcher in Ironforge, devoted to uncovering the nature of Azeroth's slimes and oozes.

faq.q: What makes oozes so interesting to researchers?
faq.answer: Oozes absorb and reflect the magical, environmental, and corruptive traits of the regions they inhabit.

faq.q: Does this follow an earlier task for Laris?
faq.answer: Yes. Laris first asked for oozes to study, but those samples carried Felwood's demonic taint. Now he seeks untarnished slimes.

faq.q: What does Laris intend to do with the samples?
faq.answer: Laris plans to compare pure samples with corrupted ones and learn how changes in an environment affect living creatures and the wider population of Azeroth.

angles.text: As a gnome, you can appreciate Laris's careful method: he isolates variables and seeks an uncontaminated control group before drawing broad conclusions.
As an Alliance adventurer, you travel from Ironforge into Kalimdor's untamed wilds to support gnomish research.
